title: Technical Ai Project Manager / Qa Lead
description:
ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals.

Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, OpenClaw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery.

THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS

ContentJet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge.

Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod.

THE ROLE

You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break.

You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via OpenClaw) or an automation (via n8n), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect.
  • Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the "human-in-the-loop" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment.
  • Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team.
  • Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect.
  • Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA.
  • Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the ContentJet staff on how to use the new system.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly.
  • Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break.
  • Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball.
  • UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect.
  • Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides.

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers.
  • Hands-on experience with Monday.com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs.
  • Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows.
  • Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST).

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system.
  • Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff.
  • Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

  • Nombres d’heures hebdomadaires : Temps complet, 36.5h avec une alternance de semaine courte à 34h30 (du mardi au vendredi) et de semaine longue à 38h30 (du mardi au samedi).

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

Responsável pelo planejamento, gestão e controle das atividades comerciais da unidade, assegurando o cumprimento das metas de volume, receita, margem e desempenho da rede de revendedores. Atua diretamente na gestão da operação comercial de venda indireta, promovendo crescimento sustentável, alta performance e melhoria contínua dos resultados.

Responsabilidades:

Gestão Comercial e de Resultados

  • Garantir o atingimento das metas comerciais, com foco em volume de vendas, margem, giro de vasilhame e inadimplência.
  • Acompanhar o mercado regional de GLP, analisando preços, concorrência e tendências nos diversos canais.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento (despesas, receitas, volumes), adotando ações para correção de desvios.
  • Monitorar a carteira de revendedores, analisando performance, variações e potenciais de expansão.

Garantir a confiabilidade das instalações elétricas prediais por meio da realização de testes e manutenção.

Identificar causas de falhas nas instalações elétricas, corrigindo os defeitos associados.

Vistoriar instalações novas e antigas, para verificar se estão dentro das normas e se estão funcionando corretamente.

Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades realizadas.

Substituir e reparar componentes elétricos danificados.

Logística:

Realizar transporte de materiais utilizando veículo da empresa, respeitando legislações e normas.

Colaborar com outros profissionais da área de manutenção, como pedreiros, encanadores e técnicos de ar condicionado.

Comunicar-se de forma clara e eficiente com os superiores e colegas de trabalho.

Engenheiro de Dados Júnior

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.

Responsabilidades diárias

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;

  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;

  • Noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards);
  • Conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Benefícios

title: FARMACÊUTICO (INCLUSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA) – CASSI BAHIA
description:
Na CASSI somos movidos pelo propósito que é o de “Cuidar do participante em todas as fases da sua vida”, ainda que façamos parte de uma equipe de atividade meio ou fim, nosso propósito é único e sempre voltado ao participante da CASSI.

Por isso acreditamos que o Farmacêutico não é somente um cargo, mas participa ativamente da construção de estratégias para uma CASSI cada dia melhor.

Precisamos de pessoas que estejam dispostas a aprender e multiplicar conhecimento, avaliar e trocar ideias sobre o processo com a ótica de que podemos estar em constantes mudanças e melhorias.

Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis, incluindo pessoas com deficiência (PcD), pessoas negras, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+, 50+, entre outros grupos minorizados.

Caso você precise de algum recurso ou adaptação para participar do processo seletivo ou exercer suas atividades, por favor, informe no campo “Descrição das atividades”. Estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente acessível e acolhedor para todos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estabelecer e conduzir relação de cuidado centrada no participante.
  • Realizar consulta farmacêutica individual ao participante, com aplicação dos princípios e conceitos da farmácia clínica, incluindo as orientações relacionadas ao uso racional e seguro do medicamento.
  • Realizar acompanhamento farmacoterapêutico de participantes com condições complexas, analisando a indicação, efetividade, segurança e adesão da terapia medicamentosa.
  • Realizar intervenções farmacêuticas e emitir parecer farmacêutico a outros membros da equipe de saúde, com o propósito de auxiliar na seleção, adição, substituição, ajuste ou interrupção da farmacoterapia do paciente.
  • Participar e promover discussões de casos clínicos de forma integrada com os demais membros da equipe de saúde.
  • Identificar, avaliar e intervir nas interações medicamentosas indesejadas e clinicamente significantes.
  • Promover vigilância farmacológica e apoiar tecnicamente a investigação, o acompanhamento e a elucidação de eventos adversos associados a terapia medicamentosa.
  • Realizar visita/atendimento domiciliar a participantes com condições complexas, para acompanhamento longitudinal de sua saúde e realização de intervenções farmacêuticas, seguindo os protocolos e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Realizar apoio matricial com os demais profissionais da APS, inclusive com agenda para momentos de interconsulta, potencializando a resolutividade da equipe.
  • Responder pela programação, aquisição, armazenagem e dispensação / administração de medicamentos na CliniCASSI.
  • Realizar em conjunto com a equipe de enfermagem, o controle e distribuição de medicamentos na CliniCASSI, recebendo, conferindo, armazenando e verificando quantidade, características físicas, validade e lote dos insumos.
  • Elaborar, implementar e manter atualizadas rotinas, protocolos e fluxos relacionados as práticas de saúde locais desenvolvidas nos serviços próprios, seguindo as normas e diretrizes da CASSI.
  • Participar do planejamento, divulgação, execução e avaliação das atividades e estratégias voltadas a educação em saúde, nos atendimentos individuais e coletivos, estimulando o autocuidado e a autonomia do participante.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e administrativas.
  • Executar outras tarefas compatíveis com as exigências para o exercício da função.

Requisitos e qualificações

PRÉ-REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Superior completo em Farmácia.
  • Registro no Conselho Regional de Farmácia (CRF).
  • Experiência na área.

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Farmácia Clínica, Gestão da Assistência Farmacêutica, Atenção Primária à Saúde, Saúde Coletiva, Farmácia Hospitalar/Clínica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Cursos de atualização ou capacitação em cuidado farmacêutico, uso racional de medicamentos, segurança do paciente, farmacovigilância ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento de protocolos clínicos, diretrizes terapêuticas e boas práticas em APS.
  • Noções de vigilância em saúde e farmacovigilância.

description:

If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? title: Support Specialist
description: At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip! About the opportunity As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F. This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that? Key Responsibilities: Troubleshooting & Problem Solving Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues. Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices. Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video. Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner. Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs. Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems. Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem. Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution. Skills & Qualifications: Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Experience: Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications: Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms. Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip Passion for helping others internally and externally Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! title: Analista De Controladoria Sr (Comercial)
description: A Caltec é uma indústria brasileira do ramo mineral, localizada em Itaperuçu-PR. Com 80 anos de história é especialista na transformação de minerais brutos em produtos com engenharia aplicada, que geram soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para diversos mercados. Atua em setores como siderurgia, celulose, açúcar, agronegócio e logística. Com um parque industrial moderno e mineração própria, movimenta mais de 1,2 milhão de toneladas anuais, possui logística integrada e forte investimento em pesquisa, ciência e tecnologia, a Caltec é referência nacional em ferticorretivos e pioneira na técnica da Ferticorreção, alia evolução tecnológica e sustentabilidade promovendo eficiência produtiva com responsabilidade ambiental. Atividades: ●Gestão de Relacionamento: Realizar o planejamento estratégico de visitas via CRM, garantindo a execução rigorosa das rotas e o cumprimento das metas de atendimento. ●Expansão de Mercado: Gerir e prospectar carteiras de clientes de forma ativa, identificando novas oportunidades de negócio na região. ●Suporte Técnico e Capacitação: Ministrar treinamentos técnicos e prestar assistência especializada tanto para canais de distribuição quanto para o cliente final. ●Desenvolvimento de Campo: Identificar, preparar e conduzir áreas de teste/demonstração após a formalização das negociações. ●Geração de Demanda: Apresentar resultados de performance através da instalação de campos demonstrativos (lado a lado/demoplots), consolidando a autoridade técnica da marca. Requisitos e qualificações: ●Formação Superior completa em Agronomia. ●Sólido conhecimento técnico nas culturas predominantes da região. ●Domínio do mercado de Fertilizantes e nutrição vegetal. ●Experiência comprovada em vendas de insumos agrícolas.

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role: As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance. Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. ● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;
● Definir e acompanharrotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);
● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;
● Desenvolver emanter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);
● Elaborar e gerenciarartefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;
● Apoiar squadsna modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;
● Conduzir análises decapacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;
● Avaliar e introduzirtecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;
● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;
● Propor e desenvolverPoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;
● Colaborar comData & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;
● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);
● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER: ● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável) ● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos ● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência Bancos de Dados e Persistência ● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos) ● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic) Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade ● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready ● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal)) ● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers Segurança e Compliance ● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS ● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia ● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial) Metodologias e Governança Técnica ● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna ● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados ● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.Io Mentalidade e Comportamentos ● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas ● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua DIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos. title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. title: Engineer Manager

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti’s broader mission. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. - Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth. - Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development. - Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions. - Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value. - Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation. - Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team’s scope. - Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts. WHAT IT TAKES - Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment. - Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS). - Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members. - Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices. - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment. Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Be fully aligned to our core values: - Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. - Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. - Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. - Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. WHAT WE OFFER - Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style. - Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. - Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. - Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all. - Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. - An open organisation. Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued. Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.
